name: Members Running Low
query:
Select pp.name,pp.member,pp.credits_remaining,pp.expiry_date,pp.status 
from `tabPackage Purchase` pp
where pp.status = "Active" and pp.credits_remaining <=
(
    select s.value  
    from `tabSingles` s
    where s.doctype = "Studio Settings"
    and s.field = "low_balance_alert_threshold"
)
